summary: Restructure plan to (a) reframe Phase A Gemma 4 12B as the shipped baseline (not an experiment), (b) document Phases D-H as architectural changes in CH4/CH6/AP_C, (c) add per-case Q&A vs golden tables in a new AP_D, (d) document Claude live tests as informal qualitative evidence in a new AP_E with explicit user_live_test=true flag. CH3 receives a one-paragraph "model migration note" so Phases 1-9 keep their methodological validity on Qwen 9B while final-state shipped model becomes Gemma 4 12B. CH4 §4.3 / §4.5 grow new sub-sections for runtime LLM swap (Phase D), per-model prompt versioning (Phase G), and the BM25+keyword+bge-reranker-v2-m3 hybrid retrieval stack (Phase H). CH6 §6.5.5/6.5.6/6.5.7 are extended (not rewritten) with Phase G/H rows, the 7/8 live-PASS headline, and an updated "Final shipped" sentence. AP_C closing summary and Phase A status header are rewritten to drop the "experiment" framing and AP_D/AP_E are appended. Phases 1-6 on Qwen retain narrative position as "methodology proven on baseline model" — no rewrite of iter1-iter9 rows.

sections_to_modify.description: Replace the Qwen3.5 Opus 9B (Local) vs Qwen3 Max (Cloud) decision table with a three-column comparison: Qwen3.5 Opus 9B (baseline iteration model), Gemma 4 12B (shipped local model), Qwen3 Max (cloud fallback). Add a 'Migration note' paragraph stating Qwen 9B was the experimental baseline used through iter1-iter9 to prove the iteration methodology, and that the final shipped configuration uses Gemma 4 12B via runtime hot-swap (Phase A, §6.5.5). Keep the existing decision rationale intact for cloud Qwen3 Max as fallback.
sections_to_modify.rationale: User's framing: Qwen 9B was methodologically valid for iter1-9; don't rewrite those — but the shipped artifact is Gemma 4 12B. A one-paragraph migration note preserves the prior narrative without invalidating it.

sections_to_modify.description: Append a short paragraph noting that the backtest pipeline was designed model-agnostically (judge held fixed at DeepSeek Chat v3.1 T=0.0; chatbot LLM is the swept variable), which is what enabled the Qwen 9B → Gemma 4 12B migration to be evaluated at zero re-instrumentation cost. Reference the Phase A swap as the canonical example.
sections_to_modify.rationale: Explains methodologically why the model migration did not invalidate the backtest pipeline — judge and dataset are decoupled from the chatbot LLM under test.

sections_to_modify.section: §4.3 LangGraph Agent Design — new §4.3.4 'Runtime LLM swap and per-model prompt versioning'
sections_to_modify.description: New sub-section documenting: (a) the runtime `PUT /settings/llm` hot-swap endpoint (Phase A enabler), (b) per-model prompt overrides keyed by model id under `src/hotel_guardrails/config/prompts/<model>.yml` with fallback to base prompts.yml (Phase G). Show a code block of the override-resolution order and an example gemma4-specific tightening rule. Cross-reference §6.5.5e for the empirical result.
sections_to_modify.rationale: Phases A and G are architectural, not just experimental knobs. They belong in System Design so a reader understands the shipped system without having to read CH6.

sections_to_modify.section: §4.5 RAG Pipeline Design — new §4.5.2 'Hybrid retrieval stack (Phase H)'
sections_to_modify.description: New sub-section documenting the Phase H stack: keyword extraction → BM25 sparse channel → vector channel → reciprocal-rank fusion → bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder rerank → top-k=5. Include a small diagram (Fig_4.5_Hybrid_Retrieval.png) and the rationale for why this works on Gemma 4 12B where the Phase B Qwen3-0.6B reranker did not on iter3 Qwen 9B. Note: 49-chunk Qdrant index and chunk_size=1000 from iter3 retained.
sections_to_modify.rationale: Phase H landed and is the shipped retrieval stack. Putting it in System Design lets the reader see the final architecture without inferring it from CH6 prose.

sections_to_modify.description: Update the system-architecture caption to name 'Gemma 4 12B (Ollama, local)' as the primary LLM and 'Qwen3 Max (OpenRouter, fallback)'. Remove or rephrase any text that names Qwen 9B as the current primary.
sections_to_modify.rationale: Aligns the shipped-system framing with the new model selection.

sections_to_modify.description: Replace the line 'Final shipped configuration (Phase A): Local LLM = gemma4:12b … no reranker …' with 'Final shipped configuration (Phase A + G + H): Local LLM = gemma4:12b (per-model prompt overrides active, Phase G), iter3 chunking (chunk_size=1000, 49 Qdrant chunks), hybrid BM25+vector retrieval with bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder (Phase H), num_docs=5, temperature=0.3, pricing pre-fetch helper active.' Keep all iter1-iter9 and Phase A-C rows verbatim; they remain the narrative of what was tried.
sections_to_modify.rationale: User's exact ask: change the single 'Final shipped' sentence, do not rewrite the iteration rows.

sections_to_modify.description: Add a short discussion paragraph (3-5 sentences) titled 'On the Qwen-to-Gemma migration'. Argue that the Phase F variance baseline (σ=1.58 pp) shows Phase A's +1.0 pp delta is statistically indistinguishable from Qwen 9B on aggregate strict pass, so the migration is justified on qualitative grounds (cleaner CN/TH output, no Thai unit fragment leaks, better politeness markers) rather than on a headline accuracy number — and that the iter1-iter9 methodology proven on Qwen 9B transferred cleanly to Gemma 4 12B without re-instrumentation.
sections_to_modify.rationale: Gives the reader an honest framing of why the shipped model changed despite the aggregate delta being inside noise.

qwen_decommission_narrative: Do NOT rewrite iter1-iter9. They were methodologically valid on Qwen 9B and they prove the iteration loop works — which is a contribution of the thesis. Instead, insert a one-paragraph 'Model migration note' at the END of §3.3.3 (LLM Model Selection): 'The iterative improvement loop (Chapter 6 §6.5.5, iter1-iter9) was conducted on Qwen3.5-Opus 9B as the baseline local LLM. At the conclusion of that loop the team performed a runtime model swap to Gemma 4 12B (Phase A, §6.5.5) which is now the shipped local LLM. The 9B configuration is retained only as a historical reference point that establishes the iteration methodology; all post-Phase-A architectural changes (Phases D, G, H) and all shipped artifacts are built against Gemma 4 12B. The Phase F variance baseline (σ=1.58 pp on a 5-run rerun, §6.5.5d) shows that the aggregate strict-pass delta between Qwen 9B and Gemma 4 12B is inside one standard deviation of the noise floor; the migration is therefore justified on qualitative grounds — cleaner CN/TH output, no Thai-unit-fragment leakage in CN responses, more reliable politeness markers — and on the strategic value of being able to layer Phases G (per-model prompt versioning) and H (hybrid retrieval + bge-reranker-v2-m3) on top, which the 9B model could not absorb (see Phase B revert).' Mirror the same paragraph as a callout at the top of CH4 §4.2 and at the top of CH6 §6.5. This preserves the prior narrative without forcing a rewrite, while making the shipped-model status of Gemma 4 12B unambiguous to any reader.
claude_live_test_treatment: Place the Claude live tests in a new appendix AP_E ('Claude manual verification log') — NOT in the main CH6 eval numbers. Every row carries an explicit `user_live_test=true` boolean and the header carries a Limitations block stating: (1) n=8, not statistically powered; (2) adjudicator is a single LLM instance (Claude), not a panel of human reviewers, so this is qualitative confirmation rather than independent ground truth; (3) no Wilson CI is reported because the sample is too small and the adjudicator is not blinded; (4) the 7/8 PASS headline is reported as a qualitative signal that Phase H closed the rag_miss and hard_negative_hallucination defects observed under Phase A alone, not as an updated pass-rate number that supersedes the §6.5.6 figure. State the VALUE explicitly: (a) end-to-end real-API verification of the shipped Phase A+G+H stack outside the cached backtest pipeline, catching any regression that would be invisible to a cache-warmed run; (b) qualitative inspection of CN/TH output quality that the LLM judge does not score (politeness markers, unit fragments, code-switching cleanliness); (c) hard-negative refusal verification (no casino, no helipad, no underwater suite) on freshly-phrased inputs not in the golden set. Cross-reference AP_E from CH6 §6.5.5f and from §6.5.7 threats-to-validity. Do NOT use AP_E numbers in any aggregate or headline comparison; treat it strictly as supplementary qualitative evidence.

new_appendices.contents: §D.1 'Golden set (25 cases)' — full per-case table T_AP_D_1 covering K01-K08, B01-B06, G01-G04, L01-L03, E01-E04 with shipped Gemma 4 12B + Phase G + Phase H responses, keyword hit rate, language check, strict pass, judge verdict, and a notes column citing the retrieved chunk. §D.2 'Strategic backtest stratified sample (96 cases, Phase A+G+H)' — compact per-case roll-up T_AP_D_2 with stratum tag, gold answer, response summary, defect buckets (if any), strict pass, and Δ vs Phase A. §D.3 'Per-stratum aggregate' — small summary table with strict pass rate per (domain, language) cell at Phase A vs Phase A+G+H so the reader can locate the deltas without diffing two 96-row tables. §D.4 'Reading guide' — short paragraph explaining that strict pass is the headline metric, that defect-bucket tags follow the §6.5.3 taxonomy, and that AP_D rows are sourced from eval/results/_workflow_3retrieval/ and eval/results/_workflow_makeclaude/ JSON artifacts (file paths cited explicitly so the reader can reproduce).

new_appendices.title: Claude manual verification log — informal live-test adjudication (user_live_test=true)
new_appendices.contents: §E.0 'Limitations' (read this first) — bullet list explicitly stating n=8, single-adjudicator (Claude), no Wilson CI, not blinded, supplementary-only, never used in headline numbers. §E.1 'Summary' — headline table T_AP_E_livetest with 7/8 PASS at Phase A+G+H, broken down by category (knowledge, booking, refusal, multi-lang). §E.2 'Per-case detail' — one block per live case with: live_case_id, category, full input verbatim, full shipped response verbatim, Claude's adjudication (PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL), Claude's 1-2 sentence rationale, the user_live_test=true flag, and the corresponding eval/results JSON artifact path (e.g. test_chinese_leak_extended.json, _workflow_makeclaude/antiHalluc.json). §E.3 'What this confirms and what it does not' — short prose paragraph: what the live tests confirm (Phase H closed rag_miss and hard-negative hallucination on freshly-phrased inputs; CN/TH output quality is qualitatively cleaner under gemma4 than under Qwen 9B; the runtime hot-swap and per-model prompt overrides do not break on first call) and what they do not confirm (no statistical claim of pass-rate improvement; no replacement for the 261-case strategic backtest; no independent ground truth). §E.4 'Cross-references' — list of all CH6 sections that cite AP_E as informal evidence (§6.5.5f, §6.5.7).
